evidence.reviewer_disagreement_reviewed: No disagreement between the reviewer roles. The verifying session independently re-ran the gate rather than trusting the builder report, because the CTO gate logged 'acceptance is not executable' on the build dispatch and fell back to a generic probe, meaning the builder's own acceptance was never enforced. evidence.winner_rationale: Internal links are the only freeze-safe discovery mechanism available. The inventory freeze sets allowedNewIndexableUrls to 0, so the hub cannot enter the sitemap without a deliberate unfreeze with a written demand hypothesis and a named owner. Linking to it from the header, footer and portfolio surfaces makes it crawlable through existing indexed pages without adding a single URL.

booking_or_authority_thesis: The case-study hub is the proof surface for the AI-shop repositioning. While the inventory freeze holds it out of the sitemap, internal links from the header, footer and portfolio are the only path by which crawlers and visitors can reach it, so this converts an already-shipped but unreachable page into a discoverable credibility asset.
